name: ME Cabo by Melia
positioning: High-energy, adults-focused beach resort on El Medano Beach in Cabo San Lucas, officially called ME Cabo - Adults Only, with views of the Sea of Cortez and the Arch of Cabo San Lucas
best_for: Adults who want a lively beach resort with daily DJ sessions and events
Travelers who want a suite with a private hot tub or terrace facing the sea

facts.text: The hotel is on El Medano Beach in Cabo San Lucas, with direct access to the beach.
The hotel is a short distance from the heart of the Cabo San Lucas city centre.
Rooms and suites have views of the Sea of Cortez.
The Extra ME+ Junior Suite Beach Front has its own hot tub on the balcony, with sea views.
ME+ guests get private in-room check-in, turndown service, 24/7 assistance from the Aura team and welcome drinks at Craft Open Fire Kitchen.
The KORPO spa offers Sothys treatments and CBD-tox massages with SCENS oil.
The gym has a terrace and space for indoor and outdoor classes.
Taboo Beach Club has resident DJs and live violinists.
The beach club has daily DJ sets.
The hotel offers personalized butler service.
The hotel hosts events such as Dia de los Muertos, Spring Break and Vogue Fashion Talks.
Guests can book a stay with their dog by adding the pet friendly service.

highlights.text: The resort is on one of Cabo's swimmable beaches, with views of the Arch of Cabo San Lucas.
One ME+ suite has two levels, each with its own terrace and bar, plus a private whirlpool, a fire pit and a DJ booth.
The Beyond ME+ Suite has a terrace with a view of El Arco, a hydromassage tub and a rain-effect shower.
The KORPO spa has a sun terrace, a massage area and a hot tub experience.
Craft Open Fire Kitchen is on the rooftop, with panoramic views of the ocean and the Arch of Cabo San Lucas.

considerations.text: The hotel is for adults, so it does not suit families with children.
The resort combines music and social spaces to keep the energy going day and night, so it is not a quiet retreat.
